data.one_liner: A library that helps users create mind trees and mind maps.
data.what_it_does: Provides widget-based functionality to create and render mind trees and mind maps with customizable paths and sizing.
use_when: You need to build mind mapping or tree visualization features in your Flutter app.
You want a widget-based approach to displaying hierarchical idea nodes.
avoid_when: You need complex geographic mapping or spatial navigation.
You require extensive enterprise-grade graphing features beyond basic mind trees.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Includes customizable path options and default paths.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and sparse changelog details.
